answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, rewards vest against future work. Work waits on the thread until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lotus of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
